_comment: Guards BREAKPOINT SITE 7 -- the same-phase Birthing Pod CHAIN (user-directed 2026-09-05: 'Pod #2 sacs Pod #1's fetch in the same phase is still a relevant line'). The cross-phase two-step (Pod in main 1, Pod in main 2) always worked -- each main re-collects -- so a two-step ladder cannot force the site. This is a THREE-step ladder in one turn: board = THREE untapped Pods, a lone Carrion Feeder (MV 1), six Forests; hand empty; opponent at 2; this turn only. Library's pod-reachable creatures: Vizier of Remedies (MV 2, inert ETB), Kitchen Finks (MV 3), Murderous Redcap (MV 4). The only damage in the position is Redcap's ETB 2 (every fetch is summoning-sick; Feeder attacks for 1 and is the ladder's first victim anyway). Reaching Redcap needs MV 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 = three activations, and with only two mains at least two of them must land in the SAME phase, the second saccing a creature fetched moments earlier -- exactly the victim no pre-fetch enumeration carries. PASS = win on the scenario turn, possible only through the site-7 continuation; with MTG_BP_SITES=119 (site 7 masked) this scenario must FAIL, the ladder capping at Finks.
